description: ocsp.rs line 371: hash_certid_input returns Vec<u8> and is called twice per check_revocation (once for issuerNameHash, once for issuerKeyHash at lines 153-154 and 260-261). The hash output sizes are statically known (20, 32, 48, 64 bytes). Using Vec<u8> causes two heap allocations per OCSP check where none are necessary. Suggested fix: return a fixed-size enum or a SmallVec, or change the comparison logic to hash directly into a stack-allocated array and compare inline (using the sha1/sha2 Digest trait's generic_array output). A simple approach: match the OID, compute the hash, and compare inline without collecting to a Vec. This also avoids exposing the allocation as part of a hot path in future cached designs.
title: P2: hash_certid_input allocates Vec on every CertID hash call
